sloka: तेन वित्रासिता नागा: करेणुपरिवारिता: ।आवासयन्तो गन्धेन जग्मुरन्यद्वनं तत: ॥ २.१०२.४१॥
transliteration: tena vitrāsitā nāgā: kareṇuparivāritā: ।āvāsayanto gandhena jagmuranyadvanaṁ tata: ॥ 2.102.41॥

translations.english: Frightened by the sound, the elephants followed by their females, spreading all the way the odour of the ichor, moved to other forests.
